summary: SIEM feed s089_single is degraded due to 8.9% packet loss (212 of 2371 TCP packets, threshold 1%) indicating upstream SPAN/mirror drops; all other checks (duplicates, encryption, VLANs, one-way, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: SPAN/mirror source is oversubscribed and dropping packets before the packet broker. 8.9% of TCP packets show gaps/retransmission holes consistent with SPAN buffer overflow under burst load, not tool ingress overload (tool_overload healthy, SIEM 1G port not overloaded).
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM receives incomplete flows with missing segments; ~9% data loss degrades correlation, alert fidelity and detection coverage even though SIEM does not require full payload or bidirectional flows.

recommended_fix.why: TAP provides lossless line-rate copy and eliminates SPAN buffer drops that are causing the 8.9% loss, ensuring complete traffic delivery to the SIEM without mirror-port contention.
